newsitem.title: USA: Ultralife stake held by Las Vegas group.
newsitem.headline: Ultralife stake held by Las Vegas group.

text.p: A Las Vegas group including Victoria Partners said on Friday it holds the equivalent of a 6.1 percent stake or 500,000 common shares in Ultralife Batteries Inc.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said Victoria Partners owns 220,000 shares of Ultralife and has the right to acquire under an option an additional 280,000 shares. The option is exercisable on December 23 at $15.50 each, according to the filing.
The group said it acquired the stake for investment purposes.
